openfilm_followup.purpose: read-only requested upstream research; no product online runtime or browser

limits: Full source extension beyond prior authored range, unified linked source-content slip and full magnetism remain open; existing basic compose slip_clip remains available.
Fixed same-product V38 authors are a compatibility reference, not an independent retiming or image-quality oracle.
Short controlled CC0 fixtures; no continuous playback/listening, natural advertising, noninteger FPS, HDR or long-project RSS acceptance.
Partial tracking/real-transition endpoint cuts and existing presentation window gates remain explicit errors.
Whole track/root processing is reevaluated after edits; concatenating an old final mix is not a general complex-bus oracle.
Complete author graphs may repeat work per visible piece; raster admission budgets are not whole-process RSS or throughput guarantees.
Wheel imports are isolated but reuse existing optional dependencies; bundled-schema and clean-machine acceptance remain false.
No additional OpenFilm runtime or cloud provider; full original product objective remains active.
